step_5_and_6_familiar_places.short_description: Where we live — ancestral Meitei homestead with open Yumjao courtyard.
Historic all-women marketplace in Imphal where family purchases handloom yarn and vegetables.
Place of worship — golden domed temple where he attends morning prayers and Sankirtana.
Regional Institute of Medical Sciences outpatient clinic for health and memory monitoring.
Where we walk — peaceful gardens and historic moat surrounding Kangla Palace.
